sections.html:
Work on Setting Guidelines for the Use of Royal Vocabulary

The royal vocabulary shown here is part of the royal vocabulary for which the Royal Institute's Committee on Guidelines for the Use of the Thai Language is considering usage guidelines. The words selected here are those whose royal-vocabulary form is the same for every rank, namely for use with the King, Somdet Phra Borommarachininat (Her Majesty the Queen), Somdet Phra Borommarachini (the Queen), His Royal Highness the Crown Prince, Her Royal Highness Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn, and members of the royal family of the ranks of Somdet Chao Fa, Phra Ong Chao and Mom Chao. Royal vocabulary also differs according to the rank of the royal person. Moreover, even when it is known which royal word is used for an ordinary word, and with the King or royal persons of which rank, one must still consider the context or surrounding text of the sentence or passage in which the royal word is used, so that the meaning is conveyed correctly and clearly.
